newsitem.title: USA: Seitel sees DDD Energy revs doubling in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Seitel sees DDD Energy revs doubling in 1997.

text.p: Seitel Inc said Thursday that it expects its DDD Energy subsidiary's revenue to double in 1997 as a result of significant unit-volume growth.

For the first quarter of 1997, DDD Energy's revenue climbed to $7.9 million from $2.4 million in the prior year period. Seitel's revenue from its core seismic operations rose to $19.3 million from $17.9 million last year.

In the 1997 first quarter, DDD Energy's net daily production volumes averaged 31.1 thousand cubic feet equivalent (mcfe) of gas, up 196 percent from 10.5 mcfe in last year's first quarter and 20.5 percent higher than the 1996 fourth quarter, Seitel said.
The company said that in 1997, the subsidiary plans to participate in the drilling of more than 70 wells, 19 of which are identified by the company and its industry partners as "impact" plays.

"As these impact wells come in, they will add materially to our oil and gas reserves, and provide significant upside to production-revenue, cash flow and earnings," said Seitel's Chief Executive and President Paul Frame in a press release.
Seitel reported earnings of $0.38 per primary share in the first quarter of 1997, compared with $0.31 per primary share in the prior year quarter.
